# AgentUpdate.ai

> AgentUpdate.ai is a bilingual (English/Chinese) platform for the AI agent ecosystem. It covers autonomous coding agents, workflow automation tools, reusable skills, plugins, version releases, experiential simulators, and in-depth tutorials. The site is built with Astro and deployed as a static site at www.agentupdate.ai.

Key facts:
- Content is available in English (default, `/`) and Chinese (`/zh/`)
- The platform tracks 400+ AI agent products from Big Tech, startups, and open-source communities
- Tutorials cover tools like Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenClaw, n8n, LangChain, and Dify
- News is curated daily from the AI agent industry

## Tutorials

### Claude Code Series
- [Claude Code Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-code-tutorial/): Terminal-based AI coding assistant deep dive
- [Claude Code Teams](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-teams-tutorial/): Multi-agent parallel development guide
- [Claude-Mem Practical Guide](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-mem-tutorial/): Mastering the memory system for long-term context
- [Claude Code + OpenSpec](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-openspec-tutorial/): Building autonomous development pipelines
- [Claude HUD Tutorial](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-hud-tutorial/): 18-chapter masterclass on HUD visualization
- [Claude Permission Modes](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/claude-permission-modes-tutorial/): Complete guide to security and execution modes

### Autonomous Agents & Frameworks
- [Antigravity Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/antigravity-masterclass/): Building autonomous teams with AI agents
- [OpenClaw Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/openclaw-masterclass/): Deep dive into the OpenClaw agent runtime
- [Hermes Agent Guide](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/hermes-agent-tutorial/): Practical hands-on with Hermes framework
- [AutoResearch Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/autoresearch-tutorial/): Karpathy-style automated research agents
- [GStack Superpowers](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/tutorial-gstack-superpowers/): Mastering AI-accelerated development with NodeFlow

### Workflow & Orchestration
- [n8n Full Course](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/n8n-tutorial/): From automation flows to multi-agent orchestration
- [LangGraph Expert Class](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/langgraph-tutorial/): Reconstructing complex workflows with multi-agent logic
- [LangChain Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/langchain-tutorial/): From basics to production AI applications
- [Dify Full Guide](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/dify-tutorial/): Building LLM apps with Dify platform

### Tools & Utilities
- [OpenCLI Masterclass](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/opencli-masterclass/): Turn any website into a CLI tool
- [Terminal Selection Guide](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/terminal-tutorial/): Choosing the right environment for the AI agent era
- [Firecrawl Tutorial](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/firecrawl-tutorial/): Advanced web scraping for AI agents
- [Agent Extensions Guide](https://www.agentupdate.ai/tutorial/agent-extensions-tutorial/): Building and using agent-side extensions

## Products

- [Simulators](https://www.agentupdate.ai/simulators/): Interactive browser environments to learn about autonomous agents (e.g. Claude Code Simulator)
